Creating a chart: drag and drop a visualisation component into a new section or an existing one,"Editing a chart: change the title, define the chart axes, change the appearance, and more","Adding data: For now, chart data is is stored in the Statistical chart data table. It is somewhat possible to add chart data using the form, but this method is still under development. Instead, we recommend creating the chart data outside of the page builder. Use the forms in the Statistical chart data table or import data from a csv or excel file. If you are using the file method, copy the chart ID and paste it in the displayed in chart column"
